svg.aria-label: Root contour for the time constant tau in 10(1 + tau s) over s(s + 2): the closed-loop poles start at minus 1 plus or minus j3, leave at 198.4 degrees, follow a circle of radius root 10 about the origin, meet at minus 3.16 when tau = 0.43, then one goes to the origin and one to minus infinity
svg.title: Root contour for the time constant tau in 10(1 + tau s) over s(s + 2): the closed-loop poles start at minus 1 plus or minus j3, leave at 198.4 degrees, follow a circle of radius root 10 about the origin, meet at minus 3.16 when tau = 0.43, then one goes to the origin and one to minus infinity

g.text: × poles of s² + 2s + 10 (τ = 0) · ○ zero at the origin · the path is a circle of radius √10
